title: Method for estimating discharge, hydraulic depth, and mean velocity in rivers through spatial interpolation of at-a-station hydraulic geometry in data- scarce regions✰✰✰

steps.title: Select upstream and downstream stations
steps.instruction: Identify the hydrological stations located upstream and downstream of the target site that will be used to estimate discharge (Q), hydraulic depth (D), and average velocity (V).

steps.title: Collect historical streamflow data
steps.instruction: Retrieve the historical streamflow (discharge) records for all selected hydrological stations in the network.

steps.title: Back‑transform and enforce compositional closure
steps.instruction: Convert the interpolated CLR values back to the original space and apply closures to satisfy compositional constraints:

substeps.instruction: Multiplicative closure for coefficients: V* = exp[log(V̂) – mean(log(V̂))]; this guarantees a*·c*·k* = 1.
Additive closure for exponents: U* = Û / ΣÛ; this guarantees b* + f* + m* = 1.
